summary_en: The video features two female chefs preparing and cooking mushroom chicken soup alongside chicken rolls stuffed with shrimp and vegetables in a modern kitchen. The process includes seasoning chicken, rolling it with carrots and shrimp, tying it with green onions, chopping vegetables, boiling broth with mushrooms, slicing the cooked chicken rolls, and completing the dish.
